verdict.rationale: None of the Secretary of State's own pages were read. The ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov probes both hit a robots.txt 403 wall, so no first-party page shows that business formation or registration can be completed online. The evidence comes from other state services: OH|TAX online tax filing belongs to the tax department, and the Ohio Business Gateway's generic references to 'Filing Administrator functions' and OHID sign-in are a shared state portal. Neither documents the Secretary of State's core filing transaction, so they cannot be credited to this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
